technical_execution.description: Code quality, syntax, execution, and proper use of tidyverse functions

data_operations.description: Correct implementation of all data wrangling operations across 8 lessons

data_understanding.description: Understanding of data structures, transformations, and relationships

analysis_insights.description: Quality of reflection responses and insights

part1_basics_import.name: Part 1: R Basics and Data Import

part2_data_cleaning.name: Part 2: Data Cleaning

part3_basic_transformation.name: Part 3: Basic Data Transformation
part3_basic_transformation.description: Use select, filter, and arrange operations

part4_advanced_transformation.name: Part 4: Advanced Transformation
part4_advanced_transformation.description: Create new columns and aggregate data

part5_data_reshaping.name: Part 5: Data Reshaping

part8_advanced_wrangling.name: Part 8: Advanced Wrangling
part8_advanced_wrangling.description: Apply conditional logic and create business metrics

full_credit_criteria: All code executes without critical errors
All required variables created with correct structure
Proper use of pipe operator throughout
All reflection questions answered thoughtfully (50+ words each)

partial_credit_scenarios.code_style_variations: Accept equivalent code that produces correct results
partial_credit_scenarios.column_name_flexibility: Accept reasonable variations in column names

common_issues.unexecuted_cells: Cells without output = 0 points for that section
common_issues.wrong_functions: Using wrong tidyverse function = partial credit

output_validation.description: Focus on OUTPUT correctness, not code style
output_validation.principle: Results matter more than exact code matching

required_outputs.description: Each section must have visible output
required_outputs.penalty: No output = 0 points for that section

output_correctness.grading: Compare output values to expected results

creative_solutions.description: Accept alternative approaches if output is correct
creative_solutions.key_rule: If final required variables exist with correct values, full credit

ai_grading_instructions.primary_focus: OUTPUT VALIDATION - Check if results are correct
ai_grading_instructions.secondary_focus: CODE EXECUTION - Verify all cells were run
ai_grading_instructions.tertiary_focus: CODE QUALITY - Assess approach and style

critical_reminders.reminder_1: DO NOT penalize for creative coding approaches
critical_reminders.reminder_2: DO penalize for unexecuted cells (no outputs)
critical_reminders.reminder_3: DO validate output correctness, not code style
critical_reminders.reminder_4: DO accept alternative solutions if results are correct
critical_reminders.reminder_5: DO explain what's wrong if output is incorrect
